author: Axiom II
title: Template v2 smoke test: preflight → run → verify (tolerance + strict)
abstract: Creates a minimal verify_config, runs preflight, executes a tiny entrypoint to emit outputs, verifies with tolerance, then builds a strict config using computed SHA256s and verifies again. Prints a compact JSON summary.
